description:
FamilyOS — a family organizer running fully on OctoMesh.
Staging/production channel variant (mirrors the OneTimeTicket.Release pattern).

Tasks with a points/sticker game, a shopping list, pinboard notes and a
weekly calendar with per-day Mama/Papa assignments. The entire backend is
declarative pipeline YAML executed by the tenant's Mesh Adapter — no
service code.

What this blueprint installs:
- the FamilyOs construction kit model (auto-imported from the catalog)
- a DataFlow with 16 HTTP pipelines hosted by the tenant's Mesh Adapter
  (state aggregation, task CRUD with server-side score booking, shopping,
  notes, day-assignment upserts, household updates)
- domain seeds: the Household singleton and three default calendar
  categories
- the FamilyOS web app (React SPA + Node proxy) as an Application workload,
  rolled out to Kubernetes by the Communication Operator as a Helm release,
  pulling the family-os-app chart from the meshmakers-apps release Helm repo.

PREREQUISITE: communication must be enabled on the target tenant. The
service-managed System.Communication.Release blueprint seeds the deployment
site (670000000000000000000001, called Pool before System.Communication 4.0.0), Mesh Adapter (670000000000000000000002) and the
apps release Helm repo (670000000000000000000005) this seed associates to.
We point at that pre-seeded repo rather than seeding our own.

Install only seeds entities — trigger the rollout afterwards with
DeployDataFlow (the pipelines) + DeployWorkload (the web app).

NOTE: the dev/test variant is FamilyOs.MainLatest. Keep the seed-data of
the two variants in sync — they differ only in the Application's
HelmRepository association (003 dev vs 005 apps).

2.0.0 (AB#5816) is the major for System.Communication 4.x: the seed range
moves to [4.5,5.0) and the Application edge follows the 4.0.0 rename
(Pool -> DeploymentSite, Manages -> Hosts; same rtIds). 3.x tenants stay on
the 1.0.x line. Otherwise identical to 1.0.5.
